tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The graph canvas and the window ground. Everything else sits on it.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text, node labels and icons on `background`, `card`, `sidebar` and `muted`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Graph nodes, chat cards (sandbox request, tool step lists), settings fields.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, the selection toolbar on the graph. The only surfaces that float, so the only ones with a shadow.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one strong action per view (Send, Allow once). Ink, not a hue: colour is kept for status.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, segmented controls, the selected thread row.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: folded tool steps, code spans, the usage footer, empty slots.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, paths, hints, the usage footer. Reads on `background`, `card`, `sidebar` and `muted`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for ghost buttons, rows and menu items.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions only (Delete project, Stop and tell). A failed run uses `status-failed`, not this.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `destructive` fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panels, rows and cards. Panels are separated by borders, never by shadows.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: inputs, checkboxes, outline buttons, the Unsorted area's dashed edge. 3:1 on `background` and `card`.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Text field and select borders (shadcn reads this name).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 on every surface it lands on.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The docked panels (PM, Board, Git) and the drawer. One step off `background` so the graph reads as the centre.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar`.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Primary action inside a panel.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-primary`.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hover and active row inside a panel.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-accent`.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Panel edges and splitters.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside panels.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The project rail: the frame around the work.

tokens.name: rail-foreground
tokens.usage: Inactive icons and text on `rail`.

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: Idle mark: dots, glyphs, graph overlay strokes. Hollow ring glyph.

tokens.name: status-idle-soft
tokens.usage: Idle badge fill.

tokens.name: status-idle-fg
tokens.usage: Idle text, on `status-idle-soft`, `background`, `card` and `sidebar`.

tokens.name: status-running
tokens.usage: Running mark: the spinning arc, a worker's branch overlay on the graph.

tokens.name: status-running-soft
tokens.usage: Running badge fill; a worker overlay's area tint.

tokens.name: status-running-fg
tokens.usage: Running text, on `status-running-soft`, `background`, `card` and `sidebar`.

tokens.name: status-needs
tokens.usage: Needs you: the kelpie's tan, the only warm hue in the app. Badges, the rail count, an area's corner pip. Never decoration.

tokens.name: status-needs-soft
tokens.usage: Needs-you badge fill, the sandbox request card's tint.

tokens.name: status-needs-fg
tokens.usage: Needs-you text, on `status-needs-soft`, `background`, `card` and `sidebar`.

tokens.name: status-needs-on
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `status-needs` fill: the count badge in the rail and on panel tabs.

tokens.name: status-blocked
tokens.usage: Blocked on something other than you (a dependency, CI). Bar glyph; hatched on the graph.

tokens.name: status-blocked-soft
tokens.usage: Blocked badge fill.

tokens.name: status-blocked-fg
tokens.usage: Blocked text, on `status-blocked-soft`, `background`, `card` and `sidebar`.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Done mark. A blue-leaning teal, so it never relies on hue against `status-failed`. Check glyph.

tokens.name: status-done-soft
tokens.usage: Done badge fill.

tokens.name: status-done-fg
tokens.usage: Done text, on `status-done-soft`, `background`, `card` and `sidebar`.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Failed mark: a crashed worker, a failed check. Cross glyph.

tokens.name: status-failed-soft
tokens.usage: Failed badge fill.

tokens.name: status-failed-fg
tokens.usage: Failed text, on `status-failed-soft`, `background`, `card` and `sidebar`.

tokens.name: graph-grid
tokens.usage: The canvas dot grid (1px dots, 16px pitch). Texture only.

tokens.name: graph-area
tokens.usage: An area's fill at the areas zoom level.

tokens.name: graph-area-border
tokens.usage: An area's edge. Its label carries its identity, so the edge may stay quiet.

tokens.name: graph-node
tokens.usage: File and symbol nodes.

tokens.name: graph-edge
tokens.usage: Edges between nodes: 1.25px, 3:1 on `background`.

tokens.name: graph-lit
tokens.usage: The 2px outline on areas and nodes lit by the open ticket. Unlit items drop to 45% opacity.

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: The app icon's ground and the mascot's bandana. Brand surfaces only: the app icon, onboarding, empty states. Never UI chrome, never a status.

tokens.name: brand-coat
tokens.usage: The kelpie's coat. Brand surfaces only. In the UI the same warmth is `status-needs`.

tokens.name: brand-cream
tokens.usage: Muzzle, paws and tail tip. Brand surfaces only.

tokens.name: brand-outline
tokens.usage: The mascot's outline ink. Text on `brand-teal` and `brand-cream` in onboarding. On `brand-coat` it holds 4.36:1, so only 24px+ or bold 19px+ text there (the brand's own pair, kept exact).

tokens.name: diff-add-bg
tokens.usage: An added line's fill.

tokens.name: diff-add-word
tokens.usage: The changed words inside an added line.

tokens.name: diff-add-fg
tokens.usage: The `+` sign and the gutter's line numbers on an added line; reads on `diff-add-bg` and `diff-add-word`.

tokens.name: diff-add-bar
tokens.usage: The 2px gutter bar of an added line, and `+N` in file headers and the Git panel.

tokens.name: diff-del-bg
tokens.usage: A removed line's fill.

tokens.name: diff-del-word
tokens.usage: The changed words inside a removed line.

tokens.name: diff-del-fg
tokens.usage: The `−` sign and the gutter's line numbers on a removed line; reads on `diff-del-bg` and `diff-del-word`.

tokens.name: diff-del-bar
tokens.usage: The 2px gutter bar of a removed line, and `−N` in file headers and the Git panel.

tokens.name: diff-hunk-bg
tokens.usage: The `@@` hunk header row.

tokens.name: diff-hunk-fg
tokens.usage: Hunk header text on `diff-hunk-bg`.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Charts: tokens in.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Charts: tokens out.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Charts: cache written.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Charts: cache read.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Charts: everything else.

families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Point at the part you mean
styles.usage: Empty states and onboarding only. Tailwind `text-3xl`.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Ticket titles, card headers, area labels at the areas zoom. Tailwind `text-lg`.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: The reaper owns every child, so a crash leaves no orphans.
styles.usage: Chat replies and anything read as sentences. Tailwind `text-base`.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: The default: buttons, menus, rows, inputs, thread names. Tailwind `text-sm` (shadcn's default size lands here).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, panel tab names, field labels. Sentence case, never all caps. Tailwind `text-label`.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status badges, counts, node sublabels. Tailwind `text-xs`.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Paths, symbols, branch names and diffs inline with `ui` or `prose`. Tailwind `font-mono text-code`.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: The usage footer, file nodes on the graph, process tree columns. Tailwind `font-mono text-xs`.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Glyph to word inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; gap between stacked tool steps.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Badge horizontal padding; gap in a button group.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding; gap between controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; gap between chat messages.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Section gap inside a panel; graph grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between areas on the graph; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; between groups of areas.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: shadcn's base `--radius`; the others derive from it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, code spans, checkboxes, graph symbol nodes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, rows, file nodes, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, chat cards, graph areas.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the onboarding sheet.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Count badges, status dots, the rail's project tiles when active.

size.note: Fixed sizes for controls and the shell.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, inline actions in a row.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, rows, tabs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The message box's send row, primary dialog actions.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The project rail; also the collapsed panel icon strip.

tokens.name: panel-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest a docked panel resizes to.

tokens.name: panel-default
tokens.usage: A panel's width on a project's first open.

tokens.name: drawer-default
tokens.usage: The drawer's height when opened.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Inputs and outline buttons: a one-pixel lift.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, tooltips, the graph's selection toolbar.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette. Nothing docked ever casts a shadow.

tokens.name: opacity-dim
tokens.usage: Graph items not lit by the open ticket.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.
